def _is_reachable(ip, timeout_ms):
    result = subprocess.run(["ping", "-c", "1", "-W", str(max(1, timeout_ms // 1000)), ip],
                            stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)
    return result.returncode == 0

def filter(self, source, start, end, dest, dstart, dend):
    ls_start = ""
    ls_insert = ""
    ls_end = ""
    ls_text = ""
    logging.debug(self.mo_pattern.pattern)
    logging.debug("source: %s, start: %d, end:%d, dest: %s, dstart: %d, dend: %d", source, start, end, dest, dstart, dend)
    ls_text = str(dest)
    if len(ls_text) > 0:
        ls_start = ls_text[0:dstart]
        logging.debug("lsStart : %s", ls_start)
        if source != "":
            ls_insert = str(source)
            logging.debug("lsInsert: %s", ls_insert)
        ls_end = ls_text[dend:]
        logging.debug("lsEnd   : %s", ls_end)
        ls_text = ls_start + ls_insert + ls_end
        logging.debug("lsText  : %s", ls_text)
    lo_matcher = self.mo_pattern.fullmatch(ls_text)
    logging.debug("loMatcher.matches(): %s, lsText: %s", lo_matcher is not None, ls_text)
    if lo_matcher is None:
        return ""
    return None

def is_anagram(s1, s2):
    if len(s1) != len(s2):
        return False
    s1 = s1.lower()
    s2 = s2.lower()
    c1 = sorted(s1)
    c2 = sorted(s2)
    sc1 = "".join(c1)
    sc2 = "".join(c2)
    return sc1 == sc2

def read_data(f, start_byte, chunk_size):
    with open(f, "rb") as raf:
        raf.seek(start_byte)
        data = raf.read(chunk_size)
    return data

def merge(a, low, mid, high) :
	left = a [low : mid + 1]
	right = a [mid + 1 : high + 1]
	merged = []
	i = j = 0
	while i < len(left) and j < len(right) :
		if left [i] <= right [j] :
			merged.append(left [i])
			i += 1
		else :
			merged.append(right [j])
			j += 1
	merged.extend(left [i :])
	merged.extend(right [j :])
	a [low : high + 1] = merged
